Activate A Strike

A corked flask of oily, black-green liquid that clings to the glass in slow, dripping strands, with a bitter, acrid smell.

The bomb deals 1d6 poison damage and 1 poison splash damage.

Field Benefit The Toxicologist research field's benefit of interchanging acid and poison damage still applies to this vial. Applying the vial to your own weapon or ammunition as a single action also uses the Toxicologist's field benefit.

Applied A Interact. Apply the vial as an injury poison to a weapon you're holding, or to a piece of ammunition on your person or loaded in a weapon you're holding. The vial is used up, and the weapon or ammunition gains one of these effects:

  • @UUID[Compendium.marquiste-additions.corpsecaps-cauldron.Item.Xm017yxcbnTbnx8p]{Toxic Coating} The vial's initial damage is added to the first successful Strike with the coated weapon or ammunition.
  • @UUID[Compendium.marquiste-additions.corpsecaps-cauldron.Item.NuxB5Opv7xI7eT5T]{Advanced Toxic Coating} (Advanced Vial, 11th level) As Toxic Coating, and the creature also takes persistent poison damage equal to the vial's splash damage.

Special If your previous action was to create this vial with Quick Alchemy, applying it to a weapon you're holding, or to ammunition on your person or loaded in a weapon you're holding, costs no action. This is a feature of the Toxicologist's Field Benefit.

Fleeting This item lasts only until the end of the turn it was created on, then becomes inert.
